newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London inch higher.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London inch higher.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were marginally firmer following Hong Kong's pre-Christmas advance overnight but trading volumes were thin, dealers said.
"It's deadly quiet. We're only going through the motions today," one dealer said.
On Tuesday, the Hang Seng index closed 10.13 points higher to end the half-day session at 13,341.61. Hong Kong markets will be closed on Wednesday and Thursday for Christmas.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was up 1.65 points at 13,343.26 by 1045 GMT.
